Maya: Routing pseudo: if form.field('enterprise') OR lead.tags.contains('compliance') -> attach Playbook.pdf, assign: enterprise-ops; if request contains 'on-prem' -> assign: solutions-eng + notify security@redwood.com; else -> growth-sdr.
Ivy: Webinar tie-in: use playbook as post-webinar leave-behind. Short email subject option: 'Running LLMs with enterprise SLAs and secure deployments'.
Carlos: I'll drop the benchmark into the doc and add a 25s webinar talking point. ETA 2pm.
